name: posterior_v4
description: As posterior_v3, with two terms at low q in place of one tail (encoding 6): the beam term, the Lorentzian wings 1/(1 + (q/w_b)^2) of the resolution function, and the diffuse term (1 + (q xi)^2)^-(1+H) of a rough interface; each with an amplitude of 0.001 to 10 times the particles at q_min; the bounds of the values are those of posterior/encoding.py
